name: Cloud sync
oneLiner: a glass cloud floats over a file window; each file row spins and ticks green in turn while the cloud fills with the brand colour like a tank, and when the last one lands the cloud turns green, its arrow becomes a check and the window reads All synced
say: when the speaker says their files are backed up or available everywhere ('it all syncs to the cloud', 'every file is saved automatically'): the rows tick under the setup and the cloud turns green on 'synced' or 'backed up'. Set files, sizes and the title
